newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Feb real ind output +2.2 pct yr/yr (+2.0).
newsitem.headline: Slovak Feb real ind output +2.2 pct yr/yr (+2.0).

text.p: Slovak real industrial output rose 2.2 percent in February, year-on-year, compared to 2.0 percent growth in January, the Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
SLOVAK INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT Feb 96 Jan 97 Feb 96

Note. All figures are preliminary and subject to revision. Industrial production for the first two months totalled 90.1 billion crowns, an increase of 1.6 percent over the January- February 1996 period. Construction output in the first two months rose 8.5 percent, year-on-year, and totalled 7.8 billion crowns.
